summary: Iter12 verified the 3 new Invite-on-a-Date enhancements: (1) Idea Photos, (2) Slot Calendar, (3) Date Chat Thread. Backend pytest (test_giftsdates_iter12.py) = 7/7 PASS: GET /date-ideas returns category_image (Unsplash URL) on every item; GET /invites/{did}/slots?day=... returns exactly 10 slots 10:00..19:00 with {time,start,available} and busy[] windows, recipient gets 403; after DATE_CONFIRMED at 10:00 the fresh invite for the same day/pair correctly marks 10:00/11:00/12:00 as available=false and 13:00+ available=true; GET /invites/{did}/messages returns chat_enabled=false pre-confirm, POST rejected 400 CHAT_NOT_AVAILABLE; post-confirm both inviter and recipient can send and see each other's messages; recipient receives an in-app notification containing the sent text. Iter10 backend regression suite = 20/20 PASS (no regressions). Frontend Playwright (RU locale): (T1) opened invite modal via profile-card-date-button, saw 30 invite-idea-img-<id> Unsplash tiles render with valid http src, invite-selected-count reaches 3/3 when clicking 4+ ideas (cap enforced), invite-show-more still present; (T2) on a DATE_ACTIVITY_SELECTED card (created via API), picking a date in date-date-<id> rendered exactly 10 date-slot-<id>-HH:00 chips, clicking chip 11:00 updated date-time-<id> to 11:00 — screenshot confirms Russian label 'Выберите время (свободные слоты)' with all 10 chips visible; (T3) on a DATE_CONFIRMED card the date-chat-toggle-<id> button opens date-chat-<id> panel with input/send testids, typing + click sends → message appears in date-chat-messages-<id> and API /messages returns 200. category_image images loaded from images.unsplash.com without breaking lazy render.

issues: The date & time pickers are still browser-native <input type='date'/type='time'/> instead of shadcn Calendar/Popover (consistency nit carried from iter10/11). Slot chip UI is otherwise clean and localized.

action_items: (nit) Consider replacing <input type='date'/type='time'/> in InviteDates DateCard with shadcn Calendar/Popover for consistency across the app.
(nit) In DateChat, POST /invites/{did}/messages appends locally via setMsgs but the 10s poll can duplicate if server returns the same id in the next fetch — dedupe by id in load() would be safer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py invite_slots: computes busy from DATE_CONFIRMED only, so cancelled/completed dates correctly don't block. However, DATE_COMPLETED_PENDING_VERIFICATION / PHOTO_VERIFICATION_PENDING dates that are still physically occupying that time window will NOT mark the slot as busy — consider extending the query {status: {$in: [DATE_CONFIRMED, DATE_COMPLETED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, PHOTO_VERIFICATION_PENDING]}} for stricter conflict prevention.
server.py invite_send_message: 1000-char cap is fine, but there is no per-user rate limit — could allow spam; add a lightweight throttle (e.g. 1 msg/sec) via a Redis or in-memory counter.
InviteDates.jsx DateChat: polls every 10s regardless of visibility. Consider pausing when showChat=false or tab is hidden to reduce API load with many concurrent dates.
InviteDates.jsx: the slots useEffect refetches on every date change; no debounce but response is small so acceptable.
InviteDateModal.jsx: is good; consider adding width/height attributes (or aspect-ratio) to avoid CLS while images load.
date_messages collection has no index; add {date_id:1, created_at:1} index for efficient sorted fetches at scale.

success_rate.frontend: 3/3 UI features verified (Idea Photos, Slot Calendar chips, DateChat send/receive)
